verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in, in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The closest items are adjacent: narrow embedded AI features (AI bill reading and auto-population, AI-powered bookkeeping automations, receipt auto-matching) and an MCP server, CLI and agent skills that let external AI tools act on Mercury. Those external tools are third-party agents, not an assistant inside the product, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
